strings.subtitle: — Wophwasula mafayilo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kukoka ndi kutaya sikupezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito batani pansipa.
strings.shred_button: P H W A S U L A
strings.ssd_warning:
Chenjezo! Pa SSD, njira yolemba pamwamba siyitsimikizira kuwononga chifukwa cha TRIM.
Pulogalamu iyi ndi ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayilo "{name}" lidzalembedwa pamwamba ndi kufufutidwa.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS njira zina za data (ADS) sizigwiritsidwa ntchito.
• Buku la USN silitsukidwa.
• Makope a mthunzi ndi kulumikizana kwa mtambo
  (OneDrive ndi zina) sizikhudzidwa.
strings.status_full: Zomwe zili mkati zidalembedwa zonse ndi ziro. Kubwezeretsa sikutheka — zida zidzaona ziro zokha.
strings.status_fast: Mutu, mchira ndi mizere 4 MB idalembedwa pamwamba. Zotsala sizinakhudzidwe, koma chifukwa cha minga, kubwezeretsa kwathunthu ndi zida za ogula sikutheka. Pa zikalata zachinsinsi gwiritsani ntchito njira YATHUNTHU.
strings.status_empty: Fayilo linali lopanda kanthu, kulemba pamwamba sikunali kofunika. Linafufutidwa.
strings.error_permission: Sitingathe kufikira fayilo. Mwina latsegulidwa mu pulogalamu ina. Tsekani ndi kuyesanso.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ndi ulalo wachizindikiro. Maulalo sangathe kuwonongedwa — fayilo yomwe ikulunjika idzakhala yathunthu.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ndi fayilo ya malo (OneDrive kapena zofanana). Deta yake ili mu mtambo, osati pa disk — palibe chowononga pano.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi si fayilo (folda kapena china). Tayani fayilo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayilo ili lili ndi maulalo ena olimba ({n} onse). Maulalo olimba alibe wamkulu — mayina onse ndi ofanana. Ngati muwononga kudzera mu njira yamakono, deta idzalembedwa pamwamba ndi kudulidwa ku 32 byte, koma zotsala zidzakhala zopezeka kupyolera mu maulalo ena. Choyamba fufutani maulalo onse.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayilo lakakamizidwa, lasimbidwa kapena lopyapyala. Kulemba pamwamba ndi ziro sikutsimikizira kuwononga deta yakale chifukwa NTFS imasunga mosiyana.

Chotsani chikhalidwe: dinani kumanja → Makhalidwe → Zapamwamba → chotsani chizindikiro pa "Kakamiza" ndi/kapena "Simbitsa". Kenako yambitsani SHREDDER kachiwiri.
